summary: Switched to the pi-web branch and started the dev server via `pnpm pi-web:dev`, then diagnosed and fixed the Pi Web mode behavior in apps/agent-server/src/server.ts and apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-agent-service.ts so that extensions (including Git) are loaded and model/thinking-level selection is retained in Pi Web mode.
decisions: In Pi Web mode (GIZMO_PI_WEB=1), still call loadServerExtensions normally instead of passing an empty array, so Git and other registered extensions remain available.
In Pi Web mode, suppress only the custom harness system-prompt override (do not apply systemPromptOverride when GIZMO_PI_WEB=1), but keep all other session wiring intact.
Use the full existing App.svelte shell in Pi Web mode rather than the previously introduced PiWebApp.svelte (deleted).
errors: First attempt to run `pnpm pi-web:dev` failed on Windows because the script's leading `GIZMO_PI_WEB=1 VITE_PI_WEB=1` env-var syntax is not recognized by cmd; resolved by exporting the vars in the calling shell before invoking pnpm.

Initial Pi Web implementation loaded zero extensions and omitted model-selection support, causing 'git extension not installed' and 'model selection unavailable' UI errors; fixed by removing the piWebMode short-circuit on loadServerExtensions and restoring session/model wiring.
